description: This file defines the interface EmailReadPlatformService, which declares methods for retrieving email-related data such as all emails, pending emails, sent emails, delivered emails, failed emails, emails filtered by status, and external IDs of sent emails within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: EmailReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to read email data within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves email data for a specific resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves pending emails based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves sent emails based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all delivered emails, limited by specified number.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves failed emails based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveEmailByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves emails filtered by status and date range, limited by number.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent emails, limited by number.
